title: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research (PECFAR)
summary: Short-term fellowship for early-career Indian and German researchers to network and explore collaboration in STEM by visiting the partner country for 1-2 months as a pair.

degree_levels.notes: Master's degree in Science/Bachelor's degree in Engineering (4 years); target group includes early career researchers holding a regular position or long-term nationally recognised fellowship.

institutions.notes: No specific institutions restricted, but requires working at academia/research institution/industry.

nationality.notes: Early-career Indian and German researchers (term Indian or German applicant refers to the location of the company or organisation the applicant/awardee is working at).

residence.notes: Indian or German applicant refers to the location of the company or organisation the applicant/awardee is working at.

mandatory.text: Early career researchers holding a regular position in academia/a research institution/industry or holding a long-term nationally recognised fellowship
Master’s degree in Science/Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (4 years)
Form a pair with an early career researcher from the partner country and submit a joint proposal
Acceptance letter from the institute/organisation of the paired fellow

preferences.text: On the German side, preference is given to researchers who have at least 4 years of experience at a German educational or research institution.

funding.description: Fellowship: 2,300 EUR per month/fellow. In the second month, payments are calculated on a daily basis (2,300 EUR / 30 days). One-time grant to cover travel, accommodation and daily expenses. 1,500 EUR travel reimbursements (for German fellow).

application_rounds.notes: Application deadlines are published on the website.

steps.text: Applications are submitted online via the IGSTC application portal.

sources.title: Indo-German Science and Technology Centre (IGSTC): Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research (PECFAR) - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Supports early-career researchers including international researchers for short research visits to Germany.
